entries.title: Parity-violating optical rotation in the Th-229 nuclear clock transition
entries.summary: Sebastian Lahs et al. — The exceptionally low-energy nuclear transition in $^{229}$Th provides a new opportunity to study hadronic parity violation (PV) by optical methods. The PV nucleon--nucleus interaction admixes opposite-parity nuclear states into the $5/2^+$ ground state…
